subject: Intro: Brynn Owens (Staff ML Engineer) — availability & resume
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@horizontalent.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Brynn Owens — Staff ML Engineer candidate (resume attached)

Hi Evelyn / Laura,

Hope you’re both well. I wanted to introduce Brynn Owens, a Staff ML Engineer I’m representing who has deep experience with production LLM infra, low-latency serving, and model optimization. Brynn is excited about the role we discussed and asked me to coordinate availability.

Quick summary:
- Years: 8+ in ML systems and infra
- Recent: Lead ML Engineer at VectorCore (open-sourced quantization tool contributor)
- Strengths: latency optimization, serving runtimes, cross-team ownership

Attached: Brynn_Owens_Resume.pdf (PDF, 210KB).

Brynn is currently on a 3-week notice and is flexible for first-round interviews next week. Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 9/8: 10:00-12:00 or 15:00-16:30
- Wed 9/9: 09:30-11:00 or 14:00-16:00

If those don’t work, happy to share a Calendly link. Also included the candidate’s summary below for quick reference.

Candidate summary:
Brynn Owens — full-stack ML infra engineer. Has shipped production transformers on GPUs and worked closely with SRE/infra teams to tune batching and KV cache behavior for real-time systems. Open to staff/lead roles.

Next steps: let me know preferred slots and which interviewers you want to meet first (system design / infra + hiring manager).

Thanks,

Samir Khan
Sr. Recruiter | Horizon Talent Partners
samir@horizontalent.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@horizontalent.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Brynn Owens — Staff ML Engineer candidate (resume attached)

Thanks Samir, great to meet you (virtually).

Dev and I can take an initial 45-minute screen next week. Our availability (PST):
- Tue 9/8: 10:30-11:15 or 15:00-15:45
- Wed 9/9: 14:00-14:45

Please confirm which slot works for Brynn. If she has a Calendly or prefers specific times, send it over. Also, a couple of quick things we care about up front:
- Recent scale targets (tokens/sec) Brynn has production responsibility for
- Any hands-on quantization or kernel-level optimization experience

If she can share a short note on those two bullets it would help the screen be more focused.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Director, Product (Inference) | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com

From: Samir Khan <samir@horizontalent.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Brynn Owens — Staff ML Engineer candidate (resume attached)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick reply. Brynn confirmed Tue 9/8 at 10:30 PST works. I’ve placed a 45-minute hold on the slot and sent a Calendly invite for a video call: https://calendly.com/brynn-owens/30min (candidate prefers 30-45 min).

Short answers to your bullets (Brynn provided these directly):
- Recent scale: responsible for a streaming inference surface serving ~700 tokens/sec steady-state for a conversational search product; worked with SRE to reach 95th percentile latency SLOs.
- Quantization/kernel work: led an effort to adopt int8 quantized inference for a subset of models, collaborated with kernel engineers to evaluate accuracy vs perf tradeoffs and contributed microbenchmarks. Familiar with ONNX/TVM toolchains.

Brynn is US-authorized and on a 3-week notice. Will attach the resume again for your records.

Attachment: Brynn_Owens_Resume.pdf

If that time works, let me know who should be on the invite (I included Dev as hiring manager).

Best,
Samir
Sr. Recruiter | Horizon Talent Partners

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@horizontalent.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Brynn Owens — quick debrief after screen (notes + next steps)

Samir / Laura,

Thanks for coordinating and thanks Brynn for the chat earlier today. Quick debrief from Dev and me (45-min screen):

What went well:
- Strong practical experience tuning latency for production transformer services
- Clear understanding of quantization tradeoffs and how to validate accuracy impact
- Good collaboration examples with SRE/infra teams

Concerns / open questions:
- Depth of kernel-level optimization experience vs working at the integration level (we saw mixed signals)
- Availability: given 3-week notice, hiring timeline and start date expectations need alignment

Decision / next steps:
- We’d like to move Brynn to an on-site (virtual on-site) loop: system design deep-dive + whiteboard infra exercise + manager follow-up. Targeting calendar weeks of 9/15 or 9/22.
- Can Horizon confirm Brynn’s flexibility for a 3-hour loop during those weeks and whether any compensation expectations need to be surfaced now?
- Please also upload the candidate to our HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/deals/HB-4821 (if you haven’t already) and share a short paragraph from Brynn on their most meaningful kernel/optimization contribution for the packet.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Product (Inference) | Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0104
